title: PPBench Pencil Puzzle Probe10
description: Ten easier feedback-oriented puzzles drawn as one-per-type representatives from ppbench_repr50.

selection_rule.type_reduction: Group by type and keep the highest-solve-rate puzzle in each type.
selection_rule.ranking_rule: Sort the 20 type representatives by solve_rate_percent descending, breaking ties by source_page_order ascending.
selection_rule.result: 10 distinct puzzle types with an easier-than-repr50 difficulty profile.

leakage_policy.public_material: Puzzle type, dimensions, sanitized local play HTML path, PPBench play URL, Puzz.Link pzpr URL, and public aggregate model-solve statistics.
leakage_policy.omitted_from_public: Official answers, encoded answers, move traces, run artifacts, replay links, AI result tables, and per-run timing data.
